tool_args.rationale: The 2.0-cost probe widens the s_grad range, helping separate sink strength from base amplitude and test the branch completion. Fit the resulting data over the full fallback parameter bounds rather than constraining rho to the warm-start interval.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the square-root siphon to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot spans only 0.018 in s_grad, so it mainly constrains the combined amplitude vmax*(1-rho/2), not vmax and rho separately.
It costs 4.5 and is not targeted at the missing gradient leverage. The pilot already reaches the target horizon.
It does not resolve the gradient collinearity or distinguish the candidate branches.
